arguments.sql:
SELECT l.status, c.types, COUNT(*) AS records, COUNT(c.scryfallOracleId) AS with_oracle_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS names, COUNT(DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId) AS oracle_ids, MIN(c.convertedManaCost) AS min_mana, MAX(c.convertedManaCost) AS max_mana
FROM main.cards AS c
JOIN main.legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.edhrecRank BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
GROUP BY l.status, c.types

arguments.sql:
WITH eligible_cards AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId, c.convertedManaCost
    FROM main.cards AS c
    WHERE c.edhrecRank BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
      AND instr(',' || c.types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
      AND c.uuid IN (
          SELECT l.uuid
          FROM main.legalities AS l
          WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
      )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(convertedManaCost), 1) AS average_mana_value
FROM eligible_cards
LIMIT 1
